subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "May I come in, sir?" Ripon said to his class teacher. The teacher replied, "Yes, why are you so late today?" "My grandfather suddenly felt severe pain in his chest. So, I rushed to hospital with him," "May Allah grant him quick recovery," said the teacher.
guide_solution: Ripon respectfully asked his class teacher if he (R) might go in. The teacher replied in the affirmative and asked him (R) why he (R) was so late that day. He (R) replied that his grandfather suddenly had felt severe pain in his (g) chest, and added that for that reason he (R) had rushed to hospital with him (g). The teacher wished that Allah might grant him quick recovery.
